messages:
Ava: FYI automated release attempted and ECR rejected the provenance upload for tag v1.2.3-rc2, canary deploy blocked.
Diego: Ugh. Can you paste the error logs?
Ava: Here are the tail lines from the publish step:
```
> docker push 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood/api:v1.2.3-rc2
remote: sha256:abcd1234...
provenance: upload failed: 403 SignatureDoesNotMatch
```
Priya: @DeployBot which principal did the push? Could be a CI key or IAM mismatch.
DeployBot: buildkite-agent@ci-redwood triggered pipeline "api-release" (build #874). ECR API returned SignatureDoesNotMatch at 1765509905.
Ava: We also noticed the cosign attestation and SBOM objects were not present for that digest — tag exists but no attestation.
Marcus: Check KMS/alias resolution. If the signing key alias pointed to a rotated key, cosign verification can fail with SignatureDoesNotMatch on upload.
Diego: Ok, do we want to unroll the canary? Change window open for another 3 hours.
Priya: Safer to pin back to v1.2.2 on the canary and stop the RC rollout until we fix signing. I'll coordinate with infra.
Diego: On it. Running: `kubectl -n prod set image deploy/api api=123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood/api:v1.2.2` then patching rollout to stable.
Diego: Done — canary back to v1.2.2 :white_check_mark:
SRE Oncall: Observability looks stable, no error spike after pin.
Marcus: Infra logs show an IAM policy update at 2026-03-15T03:12Z by infra-bot that added a condition to ecr:PutObject. That could explain the attestation write failure.
Priya: Plan: 1) Pin canary to v1.2.2 (done). 2) Abort v1.2.3-rc2 rollout and mark as aborted in release notes. 3) Re-run CI attestation job after reverting IAM condition or updating signing to explicit KMS key-id. 4) Add postmortem if root cause is policy drift.
Ava: I'll update the release notes and create a ticket for the attestation re-run. Suggested note: "v1.2.3-rc2 aborted — provenance attestation upload failed (SignatureDoesNotMatch); no production impact, rollback to v1.2.2." 
Diego: I'll re-run the release pipeline once infra confirms key/policy fix. Please ping here when ready.
Marcus: Infra will roll back the policy change in a controlled way and test signing using a dry-run cosign step. ETA ~30m.
DeployBot: Cancelled ongoing rollout for tag v1.2.3-rc2 per manual override by @Priya at 1765510203.
SRE Oncall: Leaving canary pinned and monitoring for 1h; escalate if any regressions.
Ava: Thanks all — follow-up ticket: INFRA-3421 (attestation + policy), I'll add a short runbook note about verifying cosign KMS alias mapping before future releases.
Priya: Also update release checklist to include "verify provenance artifacts present in registry" step. :memo:
Diego: Noted. Will avoid reusing tag names for aborted RCs to prevent confusion in ECR immutability flows.
Ava: Closing thread for now, will reopen if infra fix fails or re-publish has issues.
